incidents.summary: Chile's environmental regulator filed three charges against Anglo American's local unit over alleged violations at its El Soldado copper mine.

sources.title: Chile regulator charges Anglo American mine over environmental violations
sources.quote: Chile's environmental regulator has filed three charges against miner Anglo American's local unit over alleged violations at its El Soldado copper mine in the Valparaiso region.

sources.title: Chile regulator charges Anglo American mine over environmental violations
sources.quote: The Superintendency of the Environment (SMA) labeled the charges as "serious," the second of three levels of offenses

incidents.summary: British Columbia's Environmental Appeal Board upheld an CAD 800,000 fine against Anglo American for repeated permit violations at its Trend Roman coal mine, including excessive selenium discharges.

sources.title: Anglo American loses appeal over $800,000 fine at former Peace River Mine - Mugglehead Investment Magazine
sources.quote: British Columbia’s Environmental Appeal Board has upheld an $800,000 fine against Anglo American plc LON AAL for repeated permit violations at its Trend Roman coal mine in the province’s northeast.

sources.title: Anglo American loses appeal over $800,000 fine at former Peace River Mine - Mugglehead Investment Magazine
sources.quote: The late August decision confirmed the penalty first issued in 2022.

sources.title: Anglo American loses appeal over $800,000 fine at former Peace River Mine - Mugglehead Investment Magazine
sources.quote: In addition, the mine discharged selenium into three creeks and rivers at levels that exceeded legal limits by up to 350 per cent.

incidents.summary: Anglo American and five other companies jointly paid about USD 390 million to settle a class action by former gold miners suffering from silicosis.

sources.title: Zambians sue Anglo American mining company over lead poisoning | Child Rights News | Al Jazeera
sources.quote: In 2018, it and five other companies paid about $390m to settle a class action by former gold miners suffering from the respiratory disease silicosis.

sources.title: Zambians sue Anglo American mining company over lead poisoning | Child Rights News | Al Jazeera
sources.quote: The group lawsuit is the latest over Anglo American’s decades of mining in southern Africa.

incidents.summary: An application to certify a class action was filed against nine Anglo American companies over alleged health damage to coal miners.

sources.title: Nine Anglo American companies named in class action suit over harm to coal miners - Moneyweb
sources.quote: Anglo American now finds itself in the crosshairs of class action specialist Richard Spoor, who last week filed an action in the Gauteng High Court for certification of a class action suit against nine Anglo American companies for claims of health damage to coal miners.

positives: De Beers signed a five-year wage agreement with the National Union of Mineworkers covering its South African diamond operations.
